subject.title: Redesign publish plugin & skill empty states

question: Should ClawHub's new skill/plugin publish pages hide metadata, source, and submit controls until a file or folder is uploaded, instead of showing disabled locked fields?
rationale: Source review can verify that the implementation is scoped, but the permanent publish UX is a maintainer product choice and the current proof does not yet show a real running instance.

options.title: Accept upload-first after proof
options.body: Proceed with the branch once the contributor adds real browser proof for the new empty states and post-upload/update flows.

options.title: Keep locked-form discoverability
options.body: Ask the contributor to preserve visible disabled fields before upload and limit the PR to copy/layout polish.

options.title: Narrow to plugin only
options.body: Accept the plugin empty-state change while leaving the skill publish flow closer to the existing form until a broader UX pass is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept upload-first after proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with the branch once the contributor adds real browser proof for the new empty states and post-upload/update flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The current publish route and shared uploader history points to this handle as the strongest owner for the publish-flow UX direction.
